text:
lauren_cs: PaymentCo opened a ticket — their downstream parser started failing for order-create webhooks after last night's prod push. They say the schema shape changed unexpectedly.

alex_sre: Can you attach an example of the failing payload they forwarded?

lauren_cs: Pasted what they see in prod (sanitized):
```
{
  "order_id": "ord_9f2b",
  "items": "[\"sku_12\"]",   // used to be an array, now a string
  "order_total": "1200",            // used to be number
  "metadata": "{\"channel\":\"web\"}"  // used to be object
}
```

lauren_cs: Customer's parser throws JSON parse errors because they call JSON.parse on items/metadata expecting objects/arrays.

maria_eng: Hm, that looks like our structured-output wrapper is occasionally stringifying payload subobjects. Any canary/rollout changes recently? @sam_platform 

sam_platform: Deploy-bot shows a config push at 03:12 UTC last night: redwood-serve v2.14 + new streaming framing behavior enabled for structured outputs. I can link the deploy logs.

deploy-bot: Deployment redwood-serve v2.14 -> production completed 2025-06-18T03:12:11Z by ci-pipeline. Change: enable_structured_output_framing=true

alex_sre: Repro attempt: I triggered an order-create locally against prod model with the same prompt. I see intermittent stringification of nested fields in the response envelope. Sometimes items comes back as actual array, other times as a single escaped string.

lauren_cs: PaymentCo sees it ~20% of the time on their traffic — they get 2xx from us but their parser errors and drops the webhook, causing duplicate/failed orders. They're asking for a rollback or a hotfix.

maria_eng: Can you add logs where we emit content-type/structured-output-version on the response? Also capture whether the framing produced an extra quoting layer. If we can reproduce deterministically, we can roll back the framing flag.

sam_platform: I added an observability flag to the canary pool to log: response_shape=(array|string|object), framing_flag, model_version. Will keep for 1 hour.

alex_sre: Quick mitigation: we can add a compatibility step in the API gateway that tries to coerce quoted JSON fields (detect leading/trailing quotes + escaped braces/brackets) and unescape them before sending to webhook destinations. That buys time for a rollback. Thoughts?

maria_eng: Good temporary guard. We should prefer a config rollback of enable_structured_output_framing if logs show correlation. Also add an eval for structured output regression tests.

lauren_cs: Customer asked for ETA — asking if we can give them a timeline for a fix/rollback.

sam_platform: If observability confirms correlation, I can flip the flag in the next 30m for all routes for a hot rollback. Will post back with decision.

paymentco_integration_bot: Customer reported 47 failed webhooks in last 2 hours, first seen 2025-06-18T03:14Z, last at 2025-06-18T04:35Z.

lauren_cs: Thanks — I'll update the ticket with mitigation plan and tell them we're investigating a rollback option. :pray: 

maria_eng: Assigning to @sam_platform + @alex_sre for rollback runbook and to @lauren_cs for customer comms. If rollback approved we need a one-line notice to customers, inc downtime expectations (should be no downtime, just config flip).

alex_sre: Noted. I'll paste repro curl and a small script we can give PaymentCo to local-validate their parser until we ship the fix.``
